newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: SOCCER-ISRAEL BEAT LUXEMBOURG TO HEAD GROUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ISRAEL BEAT LUXEMBOURG TO HEAD GROUP.

text.p: Israel cruised to a 3-0 victory in Luxembourg on Monday to go top of their World Cup qualifying group.
With Russia only managing a 1-1 draw in Cyprus on Saturday, Israel now lead group five with 10 points from five games. Russia have eight points from four with Bulgaria on six from three.
Israel have only reached the World Cup finals on one occasion, in 1970, but have a real chance this time having already beaten Bulgaria and drawn with Russia.
Israel went ahead after 11 minutes through Itzhaq Zohar and doubled the lead in the 56th with a penalty by Tal Banin.
Zohar hit his second with a long range shot 10 minutes from time to complete the victory.
Luxembourg were hardly in the game and had only one real chance in the 18th minute when Serge Thill was foiled by Israeli goalkeeper Rafael Cohen.
